facts.value: The Transfer Achievement Grant combines all federal grants and institutional aid up to the eligible amount, depending on your Student Aid Index from the FAFSA.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Eligible students must be admitted to ASU no later than the first day of classes for the term they applied for.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Students are encouraged to complete their steps to apply and FAFSA by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Financial aid packaging for admitted students typically begins in March for fall admits, and October for spring admits.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: You can expect a financial aid package that includes the Transfer Achievement Grant approximately 4–6 weeks after completing your financial aid file.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: When you apply to ASU, you’ll answer a series of residency questions on the application, and ASU will use this information to make an initial residency determination.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Current ASU students are ineligible to be considered for the Transfer Achievement Grant.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Must be an Arizona resident for tuition purposes, must be a transfer student from an Arizona community college, must have a minimum 3.50 cumulative transfer GPA, must demonstrate financial need as determined by the FAFSA, must have submitted an ASU admission application, application fee and transcripts from each school attended by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring, must have submitted a FAFSA for the appropriate academic year by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: The grant amount varies each year and is typically awarded in the fall semester. Spring amounts are dependent on the remaining funds from the previous fall.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: For those awarded the Transfer Achievement Award in Spring 2026 or earlier, the award can be renewed for a total of four consecutive semesters (excluding summers) by completing 24 ASU credit hours with a 2.50 or higher ASU cumulative GPA and submitting a FAFSA by the above deadlines each year that demonstrates continued financial need.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Students are not allowed to enroll at another postsecondary institution during their deferment period.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: The Transfer Achievement Grant is available to any Arizona resident for tuition purposes who meets the eligibility criteria, regardless of whether the student enrolls on campus or online.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA
